## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 4 ago 2026 - 4 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Fadi Mujahid_, 4 ago 2026, 3/5: "The app is very good at what it does and I purchased the premium app. However, the app keeps Google Play Service up all the time which results in battery drainage, which is very frustrating. Unlike other apps which might use Google services to check on the purchase, this app checks with this service on each click. Very unprofessional"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 27 sept 2026 - 1 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _blackburn_, 1 oct 2026, 1/5: "Broken for a year. Widgets are all permanently glitched. Support blames Android for their widgets not updating but it's been going on for most of a year now and no other widgets I use are broken. Assume they've just abandoned the android version."
            2. _Ed Nafziger_, 27 sept 2026, 3/5: "I take about 10 vitamins 7 times a day. This app is very slow and tedious to add multiple reminders to the same habit. You have to add one at a time. Unfortunately, that makes using this app terrible for me. The "Tally Tracker" app does it right. There is no way to duplicate habits. The calendar row at the top can be scrolled into the future which doesn't make any sense to me."
<!--/ir-theme-->
